scientific_conclusion: The second radial channel lowers the PCM-energy-norm representation error for all four chemistry classes, but the preregistered 1e-4 cutoff misses the sub-1 kcal/mol maximum-error gate on the flexible diester. Lower cutoffs reduce energy error only by retaining increasingly ill-conditioned modes and do not authorize projected coefficients as ML targets.
